head: 54af268d
method: Playwright chromium 153.0.8010.12 headless, no stack. (1) The real KdsFeedPill markup for all ten states, rendered by jest from the committed components, served with the BUILT stylesheet from frontend/.next/static (npm run build at 54af268d) and the body Work Sans class; width = getBoundingClientRect of each pill at 390 and 1280 px, then again with every [data-pill-sizer] removed (the pre-change shape: a min-w-[5.5rem] label sized to its own word). (2) A blank page: navigator.getAutoplayPolicy presence, an AudioContext built with no gesture, and one built inside a click handler.
reading: With the sizers the pill is 240 px in all ten states at both widths: a state change cannot change its width.

Without them (fail direction) it is 230 px for Live/Offline and the new short words, 234 for Not updating, 236 for Connecting, 240 for Reconnecting: the pre-change min-w-[5.5rem] did not cover the widest existing words either, so the old pill already moved by up to 10 px between Live and Reconnecting.
This Chromium has no navigator.getAutoplayPolicy (typeof undefined), so on it the AudioContext.state fallback is the branch that decides (RESEARCH A7).

A context built without a gesture is suspended; one built inside the click handler is running. That is the premise behind removing the socket-callback new AudioContext() and unlocking only from the tap, measured rather than cited.
